<!-- pr-reviewer: 9b2739c221504da68db2974612ef8700925985be -->
Review of #685 (read-only, no build; docs/process only). Verdict: clean, merge-ready.

1. Git mechanics: correct. While merging main into the PR branch, `--theirs` is main, and the skill says so for snapshot PNGs (alternative `git checkout upstream/main -- <dir>` is also right). Only `git merge` is used; rebase and force-push are explicitly forbidden; `git merge --abort` on a real clash; push is plain.
2. Stacks: parent first, then the parent's fixed branch merged into the child before main. Consistent with AGENTS.md "Overlapping issues stack" (retarget the child first, then merge the parent); it does not contradict it.
3. Draft/ready: respected. A conflicting PR has already lost `merge-ready`, so a merge push is allowed, and our own still-ready PR is turned back with `gh pr ready --undo` plus a comment first.
4. Maintainer `check`: the three outcomes (head unchanged -> restore `merge-ready`; merge-of-main only -> delta review with a new marker; new code -> `/review-prs`) match the review-prs labels and the `<!-- pr-reviewer: <sha> -->` marker.
5. Safety: "same logic changed differently, or a safety rule could be dropped -> stop, abort, report the hunk" is explicit.
6. AGENTS.md bullet fits the Autonomous Work Law; PROCESS_VERSION 2 -> 3; no closing keywords; diff is only the 3 intended files.

Optional nits (not blocking): (a) the skill could say that a contributor's own PR that is still ready also gets `--undo` before the push (today only "our own"); (b) mention `needs-maintainer` among the labels the delta review can set.

Covers the agent runs dispatched from the maintainer's session; a contributor's own authoring cost isn't visible and isn't included.
